title:
CHAIN
OF COMMAND
body:
Move the [ICON: white silhouette with a tall narrow central spike, rounded central body, and low side protrusions] by 1 space in any direction.

OR

COMMAND
Choose a Character with a lower Rank.
Then, Move, Shoot, or Burst using this
Character.
layoutNotes: Portrait-oriented card with illustrated artwork in the upper portion.
The title appears in a framed panel below the artwork.
The rules area presents two alternatives separated by a centered OR label.
COMMAND is a centered subsection heading.
OFFICER is centered at the bottom.
